summary:
MARSWALK is a Mars walk exploration website aimed at allowing users to explore the surface of Mars and determine possible walking routes. This project includes an interactive Mars globe with scientific maps such as Viking images, CTX & HiRISE mosaics, MOLA topography and THEMIS thermal maps. The users can determine particular areas on the globe, find out their coordinates, and plan their routes using the Marswalk planning tool.

MARSWALK solves the Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map challenge by combining various sources of data about Mars surface and route-planning tools in a single interface. It aims at making it easier to imagine and analyse Mars exploration and demonstrate the way planetary data can be used for human exploration of the planet.
details:
MARSWALK - Explore Smarter. Discover Further.**

MARSWALK is an interactive website that allows users to explore Mars and plan their walking routes around the planet. This website has a 3D globe of Mars, which includes different scientific layers such as imagery from Viking, CTX, HiRISE, MOLA elevation, and THEMIS thermal.

The goal of this project is to simplify the process of learning about Mars. By putting all the relevant layers and route-planner on one platform, MARSWALK will be a great start for users to get acquainted with the surface of Mars and plan further explorations.

The website was built using Lovable, an AI-based website development platform. AI helped generate the website along with its code. This project is creative because it brings together all the necessary ingredients of exploration of the planet like planetary imagery, scientific layers, and Marswalk planner.

We took into account a number of factors while developing this project such as the need for clear navigation, access to scientific information, various datasets of the Martian surface, and route-planning.
